The good news is your resting HR of 49bpm looks excellent, and your stress score of 25 is beautifully low. You're not overtrained — just under-slept. Go ahead with today's planned session, but don't chase heroics. If it's a hard effort, dial intensity back 10-15% and listen to your body.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything. Aim for 8 hours — it's your most powerful recovery and fat-loss tool right now. Hit your 175g protein today to protect muscle while you're in a deficit. You've got this. 💪
